new_results.statement: For the diffuse exact-rank-two partner-selected k, with mu_k({r,s}) proportional q_rs Delta_{krs}, the normalization sum q_rs Delta_{krs} is at least 1/1152 and E_mu|tau| <= 437400000 |det Lambda|^-2 rho^-5. In the partner non-rank-one branch E_mu|tau| < 38538.837 rho^-1, hence at least half the intrinsic pair-volume mass has |tau| <= 77077.674 rho^-1.

On any leaf subset with q_ki>=a and complementary volume Delta_{kij}>=b, all but at most one projective slope lie in an interval of length <=580.948 a^-1 b^-1/2 |det Lambda|^-1 rho^-5/2; in the partner non-rank-one branch the length is <5.454 a^-1 b^-1/2 rho^-1/2.

If all eligible grouped transverse invariants at the diffuse exact-rank-two endpoint vanish, then either a complement determinant zero forces an exact two-bank orthogonal coefficient localization, or all rows lie on at most three coefficient lines with explicit diagonal relations and D=0 on the repeated nonpivot line.
